macros.name: librecaslon
macros.doc: Macro \librecaslon selects the Libre Caslon Text family.

macros.name: librecaslonLF
macros.doc: Macros \librecaslonLF, \librecaslonOsF and \librecaslonTLF allow for local use of lining, oldstyle or tabular figures, respectively.

macros.name: librecaslonOsF
macros.doc: Macros \librecaslonLF, \librecaslonOsF and \librecaslonTLF allow for local use of lining, oldstyle or tabular figures, respectively.

macros.name: librecaslonTLF
macros.doc: Macros \librecaslonLF, \librecaslonOsF and \librecaslonTLF allow for local use of lining, oldstyle or tabular figures, respectively.

macros.name: textin
macros.doc: \textsu{...} and \textin{...} can be used for superior (superscript) and inferior (subscript) figures, respectively.

macros.name: textsu
macros.doc: \textsu{...} and \textin{...} can be used for superior (superscript) and inferior (subscript) figures, respectively.

macros.name: useosf
macros.doc: Command \useosf switches the default figure style to old-style figures; this is primarily for use after calling a math package with lining figures as the default.
